name: Classic Fantasy
description: A tavern-and-dungeon starter: a gear upgrade every few levels in every slot, fifteen enemies from giant rats to a lich, each with its own moves to read, fight moves to unlock and learn, loot to sell and rare drops to chase, a world boss (the Hollow King), hunting quests and milestone achievements.

tools.name: Tools
tools.description: Pickaxes, rods and sickles for /gather. The best one in your bag counts.

greater-healing-draught.name: Greater Healing Draught
greater-healing-draught.description: Brewed by someone who knew what they were doing.

travelers-boots.name: Traveler's Boots
travelers-boots.description: Broken in on a hundred roads.

knights-chainmail.name: Knight's Chainmail
knights-chainmail.description: Loud on stairs, quiet in a fight.

runed-blade.name: Runed Blade
runed-blade.description: The runes hum when something wicked is near.

lucky-charm.name: Lucky Charm
lucky-charm.description: Found in a clover patch. Probably.

wanderers-sash.name: Wanderer's Sash
wanderers-sash.description: Worn by those who never quite settle down.

dragonfang-sword.name: Dragonfang Sword
dragonfang-sword.description: Forged around a tooth that is still warm.

knights-helm.name: Knight's Helm
knights-helm.description: The visor squeaks. Nobody mentions it.

studded-leather.name: Studded Leather
studded-leather.description: Every stud earned the hard way.

leather-trousers.name: Leather Trousers
leather-trousers.description: Sturdy and only a little creaky.

knights-greaves.name: Knight's Greaves
knights-greaves.description: Polished for parades, built for war.

iron-gauntlets.name: Iron Gauntlets
iron-gauntlets.description: Knocking on doors has never been louder.

garnet-gauntlets.name: Garnet-set Gauntlets
garnet-gauntlets.description: Iron gauntlets with a garnet set in each knuckle.

duelists-gloves.name: Duelist's Gloves
duelists-gloves.description: Thin enough to feel the blade's intent.

ranger-boots.name: Ranger Boots
ranger-boots.description: Silent on leaves, mud and gossip.

windstep-boots.name: Windstep Boots
windstep-boots.description: Your footprints arrive a little late.

iron-kite-shield.name: Iron Kite Shield
iron-kite-shield.description: Pointy at the bottom, for emphasis.

tower-shield.name: Tower Shield
tower-shield.description: Less a shield, more a wall you carry.

scholars-ring.name: Scholar's Ring
scholars-ring.description: Hums faintly when you learn something.

ring-of-vigor.name: Ring of Vigor
ring-of-vigor.description: Your heart beats a little louder.

superior-healing-draught.name: Superior Healing Draught
superior-healing-draught.description: Thick, red and worth every coin.

tome-of-mastery.name: Tome of Mastery
tome-of-mastery.description: Half the pages are margin notes. They help.

goblin-ear.name: Goblin Ear
goblin-ear.description: Proof of a job done. Do not ask by whom.

spider-silk.name: Spider Silk
spider-silk.description: Stronger than rope, stickier than regret.

orc-tusk.name: Orc Tusk
orc-tusk.description: Carved with tally marks. Lots of them.

ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm
ectoplasm.description: Cold to the touch. Colder to the soul.

golem-core.name: Golem Core
golem-core.description: Still pulses with a slow, patient light.

wraithblade.name: Wraithblade
wraithblade.description: Passes through armour as if it were a rumour.

liches-circlet.name: Lich's Circlet
liches-circlet.description: Whispers the answers. Most of them true.

stone.name: Stone
stone.description: Rock. There is a lot of it.

copper-ore.name: Copper Ore
copper-ore.description: Soft, reddish and easy to smelt.

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.description: Cold blue, and worth a small fortune.

silver-ore.name: Silver Ore
silver-ore.description: Bright veins deep under the mountain.

starmetal-shard.name: Starmetal Shard
starmetal-shard.description: Fell from the sky, long ago.

golden-carp.name: Golden Carp
golden-carp.description: Said to bring luck to whoever lets it go. Nobody does.

river-pearl.name: River Pearl
river-pearl.description: Found in the shell of a very old mussel.

lake-squid.name: Lake Squid
lake-squid.description: It should not live in a lake.

ghostfin.name: Ghostfin
ghostfin.description: Pale, enormous, and rarely seen twice.

four-leaf-clover.name: Four-leaf Clover
four-leaf-clover.description: Lucky, if you believe in that.

kingsblood.name: Kingsblood
kingsblood.description: Deep red, and rarer than it looks.

willow-rod.name: Willow Rod
willow-rod.description: Opens River Bend. +0.3 s to reel.

ashwood-rod.name: Ashwood Rod
ashwood-rod.description: Opens the Black Lake. +0.6 s to reel.

copper-sickle.name: Copper Sickle
copper-sickle.description: Opens the Old Wood. +1 s a patch.

iron-sickle.name: Iron Sickle
iron-sickle.description: Opens the Hollow Grove. +2 s a patch.

masterwork-iron-sword.name: Masterwork Iron Sword
masterwork-iron-sword.description: Balanced like a much finer blade.

iron-sword-of-the-bear.name: Iron Sword of the Bear
iron-sword-of-the-bear.description: Heavier than it looks, and so are you.

iron-sword-of-the-eagle.name: Iron Sword of the Eagle
iron-sword-of-the-eagle.description: Finds the gap in any armour.

silver-edged-longsword.name: Silver-edged Longsword
silver-edged-longsword.description: Only a smith can make one. Shops don't carry them.

masterwork-silver-edged-longsword.name: Masterwork Silver-edged Longsword
masterwork-silver-edged-longsword.description: The edge never seems to dull.

starforged-blade.name: Starforged Blade
starforged-blade.description: Forged from what fell from the sky.

grilled-perch.name: Grilled Perch
grilled-perch.description: Crispy skin. Eat it mid-fight if you must.

crayfish-stew.name: Crayfish Stew
crayfish-stew.description: Hearty enough for a long day of fighting.

eel-pie.name: Eel Pie
eel-pie.description: An acquired taste, and a powerful one.

ghostfin-broth.name: Ghostfin Broth
ghostfin-broth.description: A pale, glowing broth. One sip and your wounds close.

recipe-starforged-blade.name: Recipe: Starforged Blade
recipe-starforged-blade.description: Smithing notes on working metal that fell from the sky.

scroll-of-starfall.name: Scroll of Starfall
scroll-of-starfall.description: A fighting art written in starlight. Read it to learn Starfall.

dire-wolf-pelt.name: Dire Wolf Pelt
dire-wolf-pelt.description: Thick, grey and scarred. Worth a good deal to a tanner.

captains-cutlass.name: Captain's Cutlass
captains-cutlass.description: Taken from the Bandit Captain. Light, fast and mean.

wight-shroud.name: Wight's Shroud
wight-shroud.description: Cold to the touch, and harder than it looks.

hunters-trophy.name: Hunter's Trophy
hunters-trophy.description: A string of fangs and claws, one from every beast of the wilds.

silk-wrapped-grips.name: Silk-wrapped Grips
silk-wrapped-grips.description: Spider silk wound over iron. They never slip.

bone-plated-greaves.name: Bone-plated Greaves
bone-plated-greaves.description: Plates of old bone, harder than they should be.

tusk-studded-helm.name: Tusk-studded Helm
tusk-studded-helm.description: An iron cap ringed with orc tusks.

silver-plate-cuirass.name: Silver-plate Cuirass
silver-plate-cuirass.description: Bright silver over iron, set with a sapphire.

golemheart-shield.name: Golemheart Shield
golemheart-shield.description: A golem's core still hums in the boss.

starmetal-helm.name: Starmetal Helm
starmetal-helm.description: Light as cloth, hard as the sky it fell from.

spectral-mantle.name: Spectral Mantle
spectral-mantle.description: Woven from what wraiths leave behind.

howl.name: Howl
howl.telegraph: throws back its head to howl…

dirty-trick.name: Dirty Trick
dirty-trick.telegraph: reaches for a fistful of dirt…

grave-claw.name: Grave Claw
grave-claw.telegraph: drools and claws at the air…

frost-bolt.name: Frost Bolt
frost-bolt.telegraph: gathers frost in a bony hand…

crowns-wrath.name: Crown's Wrath
crowns-wrath.telegraph: raises his blade over the crowd…

scepter-sweep.name: Scepter Sweep
scepter-sweep.telegraph: sweeps his scepter across the hall.

bone-throne.name: Bone Throne
bone-throne.telegraph: sinks into his throne of bones, shielding himself…

hollow-feast.name: Hollow Feast
hollow-feast.telegraph: drinks deep from the hollow grail…

daily-hunt.name: The Daily Hunt
daily-hunt.description: Thin out whatever is lurking near town.

wolf-problem.name: The Wolf Problem
wolf-problem.description: The shepherds are losing sheep. Deal with the wolves.

goblin-trouble.name: Goblin Trouble
goblin-trouble.description: Goblins have been raiding the farms again.

lay-the-dead.name: Lay the Dead to Rest
lay-the-dead.description: Something keeps climbing out of the old graveyard.

toll-collector.name: Toll Collector
toll-collector.description: Collect the bridge's toll from the trolls, for once.

dragonslayer.name: Dragonslayer
dragonslayer.description: Bring down an Ashen Wyrm. The realm will remember.

topple-the-throne.name: Topple the Throne
topple-the-throne.description: Be there when the Hollow King falls.

arena-regular.name: Arena Regular
arena-regular.description: Win three duels. Bragging rights included.

prospectors-contract.name: Prospector's Contract
prospectors-contract.description: The smithy is short on iron. Bring some up from the quarry.

kitchen-duty.name: Kitchen Duty
kitchen-duty.description: The tavern needs hot food for the hunters. Cook something.

smiths-commission.name: The Smith's Commission
smiths-commission.description: A knight wants a silver-edged blade, and pays well.

herb-run.name: Herb Run
herb-run.description: The apothecary needs fresh herbs from the meadow, the wood and the grove.

strength-in-numbers.name: Strength in Numbers
strength-in-numbers.description: Win a fight with a party.

words.hazardLine: Cave-in! You scramble out with half of what you found.

traits.name: Worked seams
traits.line: The old crews left the seams half-cut: where there's one find, there's more beside it.

traits.name: Pitch dark
traits.line: Your lamp reaches a hand's width: you can only dig next to what you've uncovered.

words.early: You yanked too soon. It swam off.
words.late: Too slow. It stole the bait.

traits.name: Fast water
traits.line: The current fights every catch: it takes two good pulls in a row.

traits.name: Deep and still
traits.line: Shapes move under the surface. Not every ripple is a bite.

traits.name: Thick undergrowth
traits.line: Push through the wrong way and the whole thicket shifts.

traits.name: Drifting mist
traits.line: You catch sight of it for a moment before the mist rolls back in.

storm.name: Storm
storm.line: Rain lashes down. Rough going, but things stir that usually stay hidden.

fog.name: Fog
fog.line: A thick fog rolls in: you can barely see your own hands.

tremors.name: Tremors
tremors.line: The ground shudders. Dangerous, but fresh seams are opening up.

bountiful.name: Bountiful
bountiful.line: Everything's plentiful today, if you put the work in.

ores-and-gems.name: Ores & Gems
ores-and-gems.description: Every ore and gem the mountains hold.

anglers-log.name: Angler's Log
anglers-log.description: Every fish worth telling a story about.

herbalists-satchel.name: Herbalist's Satchel
herbalists-satchel.description: Every herb from meadow to grove. Fill it to learn the Charm of the Grove.

bestiary-wilds.name: Bestiary of the Wilds
bestiary-wilds.description: Beat every beast and brigand of the roads and woods.

bestiary-deep.name: Bestiary of the Deep
bestiary-deep.description: The things in the crypts and the high passes, and the king beneath it all.

masterworks.name: Masterworks
masterworks.description: Every masterwork a smith can strike.

forged-arms.name: Forged Arms
forged-arms.description: Every piece of armour a smith can make.
